facts.fact: The article says the Cybercrime Act of 2025 was passed by the Senate in November 2025 and signed into law, quoting an official that President Boakai signed it on 19 August 2026.
Jerry Nyantee Wrotto was arrested for allegedly creating and posting AI-generated nude images and video of Vice President Koung, the arrest being presented as the Act's first major public test.
